description: Browser-only SPA for simulating Brazilian real estate financing (PRICE + SAC), comparing extra-payment strategies, and contrasting buy-vs-rent scenarios. Pure client-side, BRL/pt-BR, Decimal.js precision, Excel export. Built with Vite + React + TS + Bun + Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui + DiceUI + Recharts + SheetJS. Styling and dark mode driven by /index.css (tweakcn theme).

Install runtime dependencies: decimal.js, react-hook-form, @hookform/resolvers, zod, recharts, xlsx (SheetJS), @fontsource/poppins, @fontsource/libre-baskerville, @fontsource/ibm-plex-mono
Install dev dependencies: vitest, @testing-library/react, @testing-library/jest-dom, jsdom, eslint, typescript-eslint
Configure Tailwind CSS v4 (matching the @import 'tailwindcss' syntax in /index.css)
Initialize shadcn/ui (components.json) and DiceUI per their docs
Create folder structure under src/: app/, core/finance/, features/simulator/{components,hooks,schemas}/, components/{ui,finance}/, lib/{export,storage,formatters}/, types/, tests/
tsconfig.json has strict: true and noImplicitAny: true

Create .github/workflows/ci.yml that runs: bun install, bun run typecheck, bun run lint, bun run test, bun run build

userStories.title: PRICE financial engine — installment and schedule
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a pure-function PRICE calculator and amortization schedule generator so the rest of the app has a single source of truth for PRICE financing math.
acceptanceCriteria: src/core/finance/financial-types.ts defines FinancingInputs, ScheduleRow, ScheduleSummary, and configures Decimal.js global precision (≥ 20) and rounding mode (ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
src/core/finance/price-calculator.ts exports calculatePriceInstallment({ principal, monthlyRate, termMonths }): Decimal using the standard PRICE formula
src/core/finance/amortization.ts exports generatePriceSchedule(inputs): ScheduleRow[] with rows { month, installment, interest, amortization, balance }
All arithmetic uses Decimal.js — no native number arithmetic on monetary values
Each installment is rounded to 2 decimals before being recorded; the final installment absorbs any residual so the final balance equals zero within ≤ R$ 0,01
Vitest tests cover: 360-month standard case (R$ 300.000, 0.8% monthly, golden-fixture comparison), 1-month edge case, zero-rate edge case, balance-zero invariant
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Prepayment engine — reduce-term and reduce-installment strategies
userStories.description: As a developer, I need both extra-payment strategies implemented as pure functions so the simulator can compare them against PRICE and SAC base schedules.
acceptanceCriteria: src/core/finance/prepayment.ts exports applyPrepaymentReduceTerm(baseInputs, extraMonthly): { schedule, summary } and applyPrepaymentReduceInstallment(baseInputs, extraMonthly): { schedule, summary }
Both functions accept FinancingInputs (includes amortization system PRICE | SAC) and an extraMonthly Decimal value
Summary includes: totalPaid, totalInterest, interestSaved, originalTermMonths, newTermMonths, monthsReduced (all Decimal/number)
Reduce-term: installment fixed, term shortens, last installment may be partial to drive balance to zero
Reduce-installment: term fixed, future installments recalculated each month after extra payment is applied
Both strategies work for PRICE and SAC base schedules
Vitest tests cover both strategies × both systems (4 combinations), plus zero-extra-payment passthrough that matches base schedule exactly

Lint passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Rent vs. buy comparison engine
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a rent-vs-buy calculator that produces parallel net-worth time series for both scenarios so the UI can render a comparison.
acceptanceCriteria: src/core/finance/rent-vs-buy.ts exports compareRentVsBuy(inputs): { buyTimeline, rentTimeline, summary }
Buy timeline: monthly entries with propertyValue, outstandingBalance, investedCapital, netWorth
Rent timeline: monthly entries with rent, investedCapital, monthlyContribution, netWorth
Annual investment return is the canonical input; convert to monthly via (1 + annual)^(1/12) − 1
Property appreciation compounded monthly from annual rate
Rent adjusted on the 12th month and every 12 months after (24, 36, …)
Ownership costs reduce buy-side investable difference; if buy outflow > rent, no investment is made that month (no borrowing)
Negative net worth allowed (do not floor at zero)
Summary: bestScenario ('buy' | 'rent' | 'tie'), netWorthDifferenceFinal (Decimal), breakEvenMonth (number | null)
Vitest tests cover: equal-outcome scenario, buy-wins scenario, rent-wins scenario, break-even detection with correct month, no-break-even returns null
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
Tests pass
